title: Agents Move from Answers to Ongoing Action
description: Five top stories and eleven briefs follow personal assistants, security queues, shopping permissions, a local coding model, and the extra coordination managers report.

coverage_gaps.Anthropic News: Article bodies were not read through. The /research section is outside the configured entry point and only the first screen of the list was checked. Original pages had day-level dates only. An October 18 item may be earlier than the window start at 21:00Z.
coverage_gaps.Claude Blog: Dates are day-level only, and bodies were not read. The configured blog URL redirects to resources/articles. External claude.dev items took titles only from list data.
coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured page has no list dates, and the configured feed returned HTTP 410. The AI-topic feed and the Source sitewide feed each contain only 10 items, which cannot establish full-window coverage. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured entry point is an old site and does not match the current official entry. Only the first rendered screen of qwen.ai/research was checked, without pagination. Hugging Face model-creation times are not announcement times; ModelScope and WeChat accounts were not checked. config/sources.json was not changed.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The configured homepage is a benefits page. News is actually on qianwenai.com/news and the release calendar, and the config was not changed. Only the default rendered view of the calendar was checked. WeChat accounts and Alibaba Cloud official news were not checked.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: The change log has day-level precision. Repositories with pushes but no release, including DeepInfer, DeepEP, DeepGEMM, deepseek-recipe, and DeepJIT, were not reviewed commit by commit. The full change log was not read.
coverage_gaps.月之暗面 Moonshot: Blog posts were not opened one by one. The homepage may not list every product update. GitHub and Hugging Face were not checked.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: News and paper bodies were not read. The z.ai English site and GitHub or Hugging Face releases were not checked.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The official site has no news stream and no absolute dates. Commits in the Step-Code repository were not reviewed one by one. WeChat accounts and the Chinese site were not checked.
coverage_gaps.European Commission Digital Strategy: A cloud IP received CloudFront HTTP 403, and the list was read through an external fetch. Dates are day-level, without hours or minutes. One original page for a €20.5 million item was not opened directly; it was checked from search results. The section is not only AI.
coverage_gaps.UNESCO AI: The page lists only the latest several article cards. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.OECD.AI: If the embedded JSON is not the whole site, new articles not injected into the homepage are invisible. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.arXiv cs.AI / cs.LG / cs.CL: Abstracts and full texts were not read. Papers submitted after 2026-10-20T17:59:56+00:00 were not yet announced and were invisible to the API. Only new papers with a first submission inside the window were collected; replacement versions of older papers were not counted separately. The published field is submission time, not the arXiv announcement time. Because the window was not fully visible, the source stays partial. At check time, about 05:20 Beijing time on Thursday, October 22, 2026, when US Eastern time was about 17:20 on Wednesday, the latest cs.AI/new listing was Wednesday, 21 October 2026, with 473 entries: 133 new, 188 cross-listed, and 152 replacements. That listing was announced at 20:00 US Eastern on Tuesday, 2026-10-21T00:00Z, and covers submissions from 14:00 US Eastern Monday to 14:00 Tuesday, 2026-10-19T18:00Z to 2026-10-20T18:00Z. Of this round's window, 2026-10-18T21:00Z to 2026-10-21T21:00Z, the portion 2026-10-18T21:00Z to 2026-10-20T18:00Z, about 45 hours, was announced, visible in the API, and collected. Submissions from 2026-10-20T18:00Z to 2026-10-21T21:00Z, about 27 hours, become visible only with the announcement at 20:00 US Eastern Wednesday, 2026-10-22T00:00Z, which is 08:00 Beijing time on October 22 and after this round's cutoff. That gap cannot be written as an absence of new papers.
coverage_gaps.Hugging Face Daily Papers: An empty list or HTTP 400 is not interpreted as there being no new papers. Listing date and arXiv submission date are recorded separately. Abstract pages were not opened one by one to check submission dates.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: New submissions inside the window were not searched venue by venue. Announcement bodies were not opened.
coverage_gaps.GitHub Trending（日榜 + Python 日榜）: The snapshot is not a list of projects that are new inside the window. Items were not filtered for AI relevance.
coverage_gaps.36氪 AI 频道（逐篇核验原创与转载）: Bodies were not read through. Items by contributing authors were not traced to the first-publication platform, often a WeChat account. Promotion judgments looked only at wording at the start and end of the body. Promotion and event channels were not opened separately.
coverage_gaps.国家网信办·网信发布（AI 相关）: Bodies were not opened to confirm the publishing body and legal effect. List dates were taken from the URL path. AI relevance was judged from titles only.
coverage_gaps.字节跳动 Seed·博客与论文: Full texts were not opened. The paper list was checked only on page 1. A year in model navigation was not treated as a publication date.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: Load More was not clicked; the visible cards were already earlier than the window. Chinese news and model-release pages on minimax.cn were not checked. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.TechCrunch: Bodies were not read during collection. Original reporting versus briefs such as In Brief was not classified at that stage.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: Bodies were not read. The section may include syndicated items, and original versus relay status was not classified.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: Bodies were not read. A summary or paywall was not treated as the full text. Suspected Insights sponsored content was not opened to confirm.
coverage_gaps.404 Media: Bodies were not read, so which investigations are AI-related cannot be determined. Dates are day-level, and times on boundary days are unknown. Non-AI titles were left for later selection rather than deleted. Some articles require a subscription or login and were not attempted.
